judged_text: zoho-bigin passes credentialId (the credential row id) as refreshOAuthTokens' userId parameter, which is serialized into the calcomUserId field sent to the credential sync endpoint, while every other app sends the user id. A parent app keyed on calcomUserId resolves the wrong record for Zoho Bigin users — or another account's tokens if ids collide in its mapping — so the sharing feature issues credentials for the wrong user on a token-issuing path.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the new call `refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)` passes `credentialId` as the third argument (intended to be a Cal.com user id). In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, that third argument is checked as `userId` and then serialized into `calcomUserId` in the POST body sent to `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`. Other integrations in this diff pass `credential.userId` (e.g., Zoom/Webex/O365/etc.). This mismatch would cause the credential sync endpoint to receive the credential row id instead of the user id for Zoho Bigin, potentially mapping refreshed tokens to the wrong user.
